narration: शेड कोई छाया नहीं बना सका था। नली शायद बना दे।
caption: The shade could not make any shadow. A tube just might.
image_brief: Paro holding the rolled paper tube up beside the bare glowing bulb, comparing the two in her hands.

narration: उसने नली को बल्ब के ऊपर खड़ा कर दिया।
caption: She stood the tube up over the bulb.
image_brief: The paper tube standing upright over the small bulb like a chimney, its open end pointed at the cream wall, the rest of the room dark again.

narration: रोशनी अब एक ही पतली धार में निकलती है।
caption: Now the light comes out in one thin stream.
image_brief: A single narrow shaft of light crossing the dark bedroom from the paper tube to the far wall.

narration: यह धार दीवार पर एक गोल चकती बनाती है।
caption: That stream makes one round patch on the wall.
image_brief: One bright round disc of light sitting on the cream wall with everything around it dim.

narration: पारो अपने हाथ उस धार के सामने ले जाती है।
caption: Paro brings her hands in front of that stream.
image_brief: Paro's laced hands moving into the narrow beam of light just above the paper tube.

narration: किनारे साफ़ हैं! कान नुकीले और अलग अलग दिखते हैं।
caption: The edges are sharp! The ears look pointed and separate.
image_brief: The wall holding a crisp-edged rabbit shadow with two pointed ears standing clearly apart from each other.

narration: छोटी कंबल से बाहर आती है। खरगोश फिर बन गया।
caption: The little one comes out of the blanket. The rabbit is back.
image_brief: The younger sister pushing the blanket down off her face and looking across the room, light on one cheek.

narration: पर वह अब भी एक ही दीवार पर है।
caption: But it is still on one wall only.
image_brief: The sister's wall lying in darkness while Paro's wall opposite carries the sharp rabbit shadow.

narration: पारो पानी की ट्रे से स्टील की थाली उठाती है।
caption: Paro lifts the steel plate off the water tray.
image_brief: Paro lifting a round steel plate from a tray that holds a water jug and two small tumblers, beside her bed.

narration: वह थाली को छोटी के बिस्तर के पास दीवार से टिका देती है।
caption: She props the plate against the wall near her sister's bed.
image_brief: Paro standing the steel plate upright against the wall beside her sister's bed, holding its rim steady.

narration: फिर थाली को ज़रा ज़रा तिरछा करती है।
caption: Then she tilts the plate a little at a time.
image_brief: Paro's fingers tipping the steel plate at a slant, the bright beam sliding across its shining surface.

narration: धार थाली से टकराई और छोटी की दीवार पर जा गिरी।
caption: The stream hit the plate and landed on the little one's wall.
image_brief: The beam striking the tilted steel plate and bouncing back across the room onto the sister's wall.

narration: अब दो दीवारों पर रोशनी है। हाथ सिर्फ़ एक जोड़ी।
caption: Now there is light on two walls. Only one pair of hands.
image_brief: Both bedroom walls in one frame, each carrying a patch of light, the single paper-tube lamp glowing on the floor between them.

narration: तुम भी उँगलियों से दो कान बनाओ। पारो ने भी बनाए।
caption: You make two ears with your fingers too. Paro made hers as well.
image_brief: Paro's hands with two fingers raised as ears, the beam passing over them toward the lit wall beyond.

narration: दो दीवार, दो खरगोश, एक लैंप। पारो ज़ोर से गिनती है।
caption: Two walls, two rabbits, one lamp. Paro counts it out loud.
image_brief: Paro sitting upright on the floor counting on her fingers, a lit wall behind her on each side.
